name: SearchVideos
title: Search Videos
description: Search YouTube videos by keyword via SearchAPI.io (youtube)
whenToUse: Pick to find YOUTUBE VIDEOS for a keyword: title, channel, views, length and thumbnail per result. Use it when you specifically want video content; it returns videos, not arbitrary web pages, dated articles, or places.

package.name: search
package.packageFile:
$schema: ../_schema/package.schema.json

# FULLY DECLARATIVE. Four nodes, one endpoint, one key.
#
# SearchAPI.io is the cleanest case for this format: every engine is the SAME url switched
# by `engine=`, authenticated by one `api_key` in the query. `shared/searchapi.yaml` holds
# the call, each node names its engine and shapes its own reply, and the whole client is
# gone: `auth: apiKeyQuery` was already an executor capability.
#
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/search/`.

name: search
displayName: Search
description: Web, news, video and places search via SearchAPI.io
version: 2.0.0
category: search
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/3128/3128287.png

features:
  - Google web and image results
  - Google News, dated articles
  - YouTube video search
  - Google Maps places with ratings

allowedHosts:
  - www.searchapi.io

requires:
  credential: [apiKeyQuery]
  transport: [json]
  executorVersion: ">=1.0.0"

credentials.searchapiCredential.yaml:
$schema: ../../_schema/credential.schema.json

# One key powers every engine in this package. Transcribed from src/credentials/index.ts.

name: searchapiCredential
displayName: SearchAPI
description: SearchAPI.io credentials. One key powers every search engine in this package.
documentationUrl: https://www.searchapi.io/docs

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your SearchAPI.io API key
    placeholder: ""

shared.searchapi.yaml:
# The ONE call every node in this package makes.
#
# Same url, same auth, switched by `engine`. A node $refs this and layers its own `query`
# keys on top, which is what a $ref with siblings does: imported first, local wins.
#
# The key travels as a query parameter because that is what the vendor takes. `apiKeyQuery`
# is an executor capability, so no node handles a secret itself.

call: &call
  method: GET
  url: https://www.searchapi.io/api/v1/search
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyQuery
    param: api_key
    value: "{{ credentials.searchapiCredential.apiKey }}"
  headers:
    Accept: application/json
  transport: json
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]

# A 200 is not always a success here: the vendor reports a bad parameter or an exhausted
# quota in the body. Without this a failed search emits empty results and reads as "nothing
# found", which is the wrong answer rather than an error.
error: &error
  when: "return !!response.error"
  message: "return typeof response.error === 'string' ? response.error : JSON.stringify(response.error)"

files.api/events.yaml:
- emit: videoResults
  from: response
  # `extracted_views` is the numeric one; `views` may be a formatted string.
  value: >-
    return (response.videos || []).slice(0, config.numResults).map(v => ({
      title: v.title || "",
      url: v.link || "",
      channel: (v.channel || {}).title || "",
      channelUrl: (v.channel || {}).link || "",
      views: typeof v.extracted_views === "number" ? v.extracted_views : (v.views || null),
      length: v.length || "",
      publishedTime: v.published_time || "",
      description: v.description || "",
      thumbnail: (((v.thumbnail || {}).static || (v.thumbnail || {}).rich) || "").startsWith("data:") ? "" : ((v.thumbnail || {}).static || (v.thumbnail || {}).rich || "")
    }))
files.api/run.yaml:
# The youtube engine takes no `num`: it returns a page and the node trims it, which is what
# the retired service did too.

- $ref: searchapi#call
  name: search
  error: { $ref: searchapi#error }
  query:
    engine: youtube
    q: "{{ config.query }}"
    gl: "{{ config.country }}"
    hl: "{{ config.language }}"
files.config.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/config.schema.json

configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [query]
  properties:
    query:
      type: string
      title: Search Query
      description: Keywords to search YouTube for
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    numResults:
      type: number
      title: Number of Results
      description: Number of video results to return
      default: 20
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 100
    country:
      type: string
      title: Country
      description: Country code for localized results, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'ae'
      default: us
    language:
      type: string
      title: Language
      description: Interface language code, e.g. 'en', 'ar'
      default: en

    # WHO MAY RUN THIS BOX, set by whoever builds the workflow (15-who-can-run-it.md).
    #
    # INSTANCE config, not the manifest's `auth`, and the two answer different questions.
    # The manifest is the node author's FLOOR: "this node is inherently privileged". These
    # are the builder's, per box on the canvas, because the same node type legitimately
    # faces staff on one workflow and customers on another.
    #
    # A role especially has to live here: `finance:approve` is a claim THIS deployment's
    # identity provider mints, and a node published to the marketplace cannot know the role
    # vocabulary of every universe that installs it.
    #
    # The executor takes the STRICTER of the two. Neither can loosen the other.
    authRequired:
      type: boolean
      title: Require sign-in
      description: Only signed-in callers can run this step.
      default: false
      "ui:widget": toggle
    authRole:
      type: string
      title: Require role
      description: A claim the caller must carry, like finance:approve.
      default: ""
      "ui:dependencies": { authRequired: true }

"ui:order": [authRequired, authRole, query, numResults, country, language]
files.interface.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/interface.schema.json

inputs:
  - name: query
    type: string
    description: Search query
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: videoResults
    type: array
    description: YouTube video results (title, url, channel, views, length, thumbnail)

credentials:
  - name: searchapiCredential
    required: true
    displayName: SearchAPI
files.node.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/node.schema.json

type: SearchVideos
kind: PromiseNode
name: Search Videos
category: Search
color: "#FF0000"
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/1384/1384060.png
description: Search YouTube videos by keyword via SearchAPI.io (youtube)
whenToUse: >
  Pick to find YOUTUBE VIDEOS for a keyword: title, channel, views, length and thumbnail per
  result. Use it when you specifically want video content; it returns videos, not arbitrary
  web pages, dated articles, or places.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (DECLARATIVE_NODES.md §9.13). Compulsory on every node, so that a node
# nobody thought about cannot look the same as one deliberately left open.
#
# `required: false` adds no requirement of its own: the node runs for whoever the trigger
# admitted. The trigger instance's publicEntry toggle still owns the door, and requirements
# only ever narrow.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  cacheable: true
files.test.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/test.schema.json

testData:
  config:
    query: server driven ui
    numResults: 10
    country: us
    language: en
  inputs:
    query: server driven ui
  expect:
    videoResults: "return output.videoResults.length > 0 && typeof output.videoResults[0].url === 'string'"
